description: This Java source file defines a factory class `EnforcementFactoryFactory` that creates instances of `EnforcementFilterFactory` objects used in enforcement filtering mechanisms within the `org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.connectivity` package. It provides methods for creating preconfigured enforcement filter factories with specific placeholders.

classes.name: EnforcementFactoryFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods to create `EnforcementFilterFactory` instances, primarily for enforcing filtering logic with preconfigured placeholders.

methods.name: newEnforcementFilterFactory
methods.description: Creates a new `EnforcementFilterFactory` instance with specified enforcement options, input filter, and a list of filter placeholder resolvers.

methods.name: newEnforcementFilterFactory
methods.description: Creates a preconfigured `EnforcementFilterFactory` with default placeholders for thing, policy, and entity.
